about_the_game:
The greatest RPG ever! (that's a lie)

Welcome to Townslife! As the name suggests, you'll likely be spending a lot of time in the local town, where you have just recently settled! But that's not the only place you'll visit - be ready to wander around forests, fish in a huge lake, get to know the townsfolk and even go to the nearest mine that is known for collapsing quite often! What more could you possibly ask for?

Okay but what am I actually going to do in this game?

The game features such exhilarating activities as:

  • Cutting down trees for wood,

  • Selling wood,

  • Planting new trees for more wood,

  • Cutting down tre- wait, you want something more than a lumberjack simulator? Alright then!

On a more serious note - you'll gather resources that you can sell to earn money or keep them and use in crafting! Place stuff around, customize the interior of your home, go mining in the procedurally generated mine, go fishing, plant your own crops, fight hostile creatures, find hidden treasures, talk to the locals and more!

How much content even is there?

Keep in mind that the game's still work in progress, and you can only expect an early demo sometime soon, so there's not that much content currently, but I'll keep updating the game and as time goes on, there will be more and more things to craft, place, interact or maybe even fight with! The demo that I will eventually release will keep being updated until it's time for the next step. Until then, stay tuned!

short_description: Welcome to Townslife - a game about living in a small town, surrounded by forests and the sea, with a local mine somewhere in the distance. Place stuff around, customize the interior of your house, mine, fight with hostile creatures, talk to the locals and more! All in a nice retro pixel package!
